concerns.text: FR-016/SC-013 cite 'Simon et al., DOI ‑019‑1234' — a malformed, unverifiable DOI that appears nowhere in the source idea. The idea specified the Figshare 'Permeability of gases in MOFs' dataset (https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.12345678) with an explicit NIST/ICSD fallback. The spec has silently replaced the idea's named sources with an apparently fabricated citation, and the prior plan-stage kickback already established no verified experimental source exists for this DOI. Replace with the idea's actual named sources (or their verified fallback) or mark [NEEDS CLARIFICATION]; a spec that mandates a nonexistent dataset cannot be implemented.

Under-reach vs idea's feature engineering: the idea requires node attributes 'atomic number, valence, partial charge … orbital information for framework nodes; atom type, hybridization, partial charge for molecule nodes'. The spec's graph construction (FR-002, US-1 scenario 2) only requires atomic numbers and bond-distance edge attributes; valence and partial-charge node features are dropped without justification. Either restore them or document the deliberate scope reduction.

The idea specifies '3-fold cross-validation (reduced from 5-fold to save time)' and a 70/15/15 train/val/test split; the spec mandates stratified 5-fold CV with no train/val/test split mentioned. 5-fold may be legitimate rigor for a small dataset, but the change from the idea's explicit protocol should be acknowledged (e.g., in Assumptions) so it reads as a clarifier-driven decision rather than silent drift.
